status: independent local implementation verified; unified integration pending
scope: explicit anonymous catalog.db only; no original database/config import or device action

compatibility.tables: existing project_base, project_result, project_sample_rate, option_unit, reagent_* and sample_* contracts retained; new tables only
compatibility.project_key: project_base.id / ProjectRecord.id stable INTEGER; never display name
compatibility.instrument_key: ProjectRecord.instrumentProjectId retained on save/copy; no guessed device mapping
compatibility.result_key: (project_id,result_type) is current local key; no new numeric result_id inferred
compatibility.units: ProjectResult.unit plus ProjectUnit.ratio committed snapshot; decimals 1..6; existing values/ratios unchanged
compatibility.history: existing result values, stored unit and decimal presentation belong to saved history; current catalog must not silently rewrite them

reads.projects: ProjectsStore::load(requestId) -> snapshotReady(requestId, ProjectRecords, ProjectUnits), value copies emitted only after a consistent read transaction; no widget pointers or SQL handles cross threads
reads.reagents: ReagentStore::load() -> loaded(ReagentSnapshot), existing fields retained, optional batch metadata appended
reads.advanced: ProjectRecord gains optional ProjectAdvanced value; absence means unconfigured, never a validated production scheme
reads.usage: QC/calibration/report consume committed snapshots, not page drafts; each module keeps own SQL connections in owning thread

external_reference_protocol.project_table: catalog_project_reference(owner_module,reference_key,project_id); primary key(owner_module,reference_key), FK project_id -> project_base.id ON DELETE RESTRICT
external_reference_protocol.batch_table: catalog_batch_reference owned by ReagentStore, analogous durable reservations against reagent_batch_group.id; exact API in reagent handoff
external_reference_protocol.write_order: reserve catalog reference, await success, commit external record; after external deletion commits, release reservation. External failed saves release only their own reservation after determining outcome
external_reference_protocol.protection: held project names and held batch identity/group/project cannot change; catalog deletes blocked by local FK. Missing/locked/uninitialized catalog fails closed
external_reference_protocol.recovery: a crash may leave an orphan reservation; explicit reconciliation against owning module is required. Never auto-delete unknown holds at startup
external_reference_protocol.limit: this is not a cross-database foreign key or one atomic transaction. Snapshot alone cannot protect a later external write. All external writers must use durable reservation protocol before enabling rename/delete with live dependent data

rollback: additive tables do not alter old records; old binaries can read baseline tables but do not enforce new external-reference rename guards, so rollback with external references is read-only until reconciliation. Do not drop tables or rewrite history automatically
verification_boundaries: WSL x86_64 independent project11/0 + prior project9/0; reagent final results in reagents_handoff.json
Windows32/ARM64 final builds owned by integration window
advanced_schema: project_advanced(project_id PK FK project_base.id CASCADE,version=1,payload JSON text with exact fields/samples/reagents keys); catalog_metadata.project_advanced_schema=sn100-project-advanced-local-v1
action_reference_schema: project_action_reagent_reference(project_id FK CASCADE,reagent_id FK reagent_list.id RESTRICT); generated atomically on project save/copy; reagent name/type/valid mutations blocked while referenced
reference_permissions: Reference bookkeeping supports authenticated actionReady roles1..5; project configuration editing remains role4/5. Receiving modules must still enforce their own original write permission.
batch_reference_requirement: External project-and-batch records reserve BOTH IDs before external commit. Batch reservation alone does not protect project name.

advanced_fields.storage: numeric strings preserve empty/invalid draft until rejection; unconfigured advanced has no stored row; sample/reagent actions optional and never scheduled
advanced_fields.units: four times in integer seconds0..999; wavelengths original405/570/660/800nm, distinct; action *_ul microlitres0..999 max1decimal and *_sec seconds
advanced_fields.cap: at most64 local reagent action rows, not an instrument capability claim
advanced_fields.unused: AlgParam,coefficients,d_T,IBS selection,hidden report fields,algorithm/calibration/apply/device commands not enabled
